meta.name: ship
meta.description: Prepare or execute an authorized controlled release with verified checks, recovery and an operating owner. Use when a customer increment is ready for deployment.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已就绪的版本经核对与回滚预案后正式发布上线
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有一个客户增量已就绪、准备部署
copy.tagline_en: Release a ready increment to production with verified checks and a rollback plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if a customer increment is ready and waiting to be deployed

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会为你准备或执行一次经授权的受控发布，带上已验证的检查、恢复方案和一名运营负责人。它直接依据你提供的上下文工作，不需要额外的初始化或项目文件夹。
howto.when: 当客户增量准备好部署时接管。若由 @fde 调用，则复用其当前的脱敏数据包和范围，不重跑设置、发现流程或已答过的问题。

say.text: 客户增量已就绪，帮我准备一次受控发布
say.note: 会带上验证检查、恢复方案和负责人

say.text: 按现有范围执行这次发布，并列出已跑和未跑的检查
say.note: 未跑的检查会如实报告

say.text: 这次发布指定运营负责人，并保留未知项

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude prepares or executes an authorized controlled release, with verified checks, recovery, and an operating owner. It works directly from the context you supply and needs no extra initialization or engagement folder.
howto.when_en: It takes over when a customer increment is ready for deployment. If called by @fde, it reuses that sanitized packet and scope instead of restarting setup, discovery, or already answered questions.

say_en.text: The customer increment is ready — prepare a controlled release
say_en.note: Adds verified checks, recovery and an owner

say_en.text: Run this release in the current scope and list run vs. unrun checks
Assign an operating owner for this release and preserve unknowns
